programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out 3-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in February 2008 when Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Charli XCX - Reading & Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of music festivals that take place annually in the cities of Reading and Leeds in England. Featuring Charli XCX.

programme.title: John Legend - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007. Featuring: John Legend.

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Usher - Omg Tour (Live from London)
programme.desc: Treating the crowd at London's O2 Arena to his signature brand of R&B infused pop, Usher performed hits from recent albums Versus and Raymond V. Raymond, including DJ Got Us Falling in Love, There Goes My Baby, and OMG.

programme.title: One Direction: Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: One Direction performs a stellar set at the 2015 edition of the Apple Music Festival. Be prepared to sing along to their catchy chart-topping hits!

programme.title: Lana Del Rey - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Born to Die is the second album by singer-songwriter Lana Del Rey, and the first to be officially released on January 27, 2012 and that would lead to global success; In countries such as the United Kingdom the album was the best selling of that year.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix - Band of Gypsys Documentary
programme.desc: This Grammy-winning documentary features the only known concert footage of Band of Gypsys, offering crucial insight into Jimi Hendrix's music. It includes interviews with bandmates and rock legends like Lenny Kravitz and Slash.

programme.title: The Lumineers - Live At Musilac 2017
programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. You won't be able to resist clapping along and stomping your feet to the band's raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen: Live in Hyde Park
programme.desc: "London Calling: Live in Hyde Park" is a concert video of Bruce Springsteen & the E Street Band's performance during the Hard Rock Calling music festival in Hyde Park, London on June 28, 2009.

programme.title: John Legend - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007. Featuring: John Legend.

programme.title: Coldplay - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Muse: Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring in Nürburgring and Rock Im Park in Nuremberg are music festivals that take place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in Western Germany, featuring Muse.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the Circus Krone in Munich, this concert features performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next to the Moon" and more.

programme.title: David Gilmour - Remember That Night
programme.desc: David Gilmour - Remember That Night: Live at the Royal Albert Hall is recorded by guitarist David Gilmour where he presents live tracks from the album On an Island and some hits from his former band Pink Floyd.

programme.title: Charles Bradley: The Screaming Eagle Of Soul
programme.desc: A concert from soul singer Charles Bradley recorded in Paris in September 2014.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing was equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs; Shearing plays originals in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Estival 1986: Jon Hendricks, Judith Hendricks, Kim Lindsay & Mart Ledford
programme.desc: Jon Hendricks is one of the instigators of vocalese, an art form that aims to add lyrics to existing instrumental pieces and replace several instruments with singing.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Live in Paris
programme.desc: Larry Graham and Graham Central Station perform at the Trianon in Paris, where 600 attendees watch the renowned bass player. Graham, a pioneer of slap-pop electric bass, shows his skill.

programme.title: Maybe This Time
programme.desc: The recording captures Tony Bennett's performance at London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, showcasing his vocal skill and charisma.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beatbox vocals.

programme.title: Quincy Jones: 'Q' conducting his 'Dream Band'
programme.desc: "Jazz Icons: Quincy Jones" spotlights a young 'Q' conducting his "dream band": an 18-piece orchestra of world-renowned players such as Clark Terry, Phil Woods, Sahib Shihab, Budd Johnson and Benny Bailey. This recording features 5 songs and is one of the finest examples of big band jazz ever to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium in 1961, this concert is one of the few known visual documents of this legendary tour.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet & Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music; Jimmy Witherspoon ends the show with some lean-back blues.

programme.title: Kenny Barron at Lviv Ukraine 2019
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv is a celebration of jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: Omer Avital -- Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences; at Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital presents singular repertoire based on his album "Qantar."

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles
programme.desc: In the 2009 portrait of Marcus Miller, Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis; he shares stories of the recording process of the album "Tutu," explaining how he wrote the title track.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk: Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk in a performance with his quartet in Copenhagen, Denmark on April 17, 1966, and Warsaw, Poland on April 4, 1966.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit
programme.desc: Stuttgart's Jazz Open Festival features Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: Big Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke Trio, Art Simmons Trio
programme.desc: Performances of pianist Joe Turner, the Kenny Clarke Trio and the Art Simmons Trio.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beatbox vocals.

programme.desc: On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio performs a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig.

programme.title: Fannie Mae
programme.desc: Jaco Pastorius, a true musical innovator, takes the stage at the Montreal Jazz Festival; he is transforming the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument, wowing the audience in Canada with his unique style and talent.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist; she brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres.

programme.title: Kenny Barron at Lviv Ukraine 2019

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins

programme.title: Raul Midon at Singapore 2017
programme.desc: Raul Midón appears at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams.

programme.title: The Great Charlie Galbraith All Star Jazz Band
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted the talented groups of Charlie Galbraith, Knut Kiesewetter, Bud Shank and Pim Jacobs and Marc Laferrière in a jazz festival that mixed new and old styles.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah at Sofia Bulgaria 2019
programme.desc: In 2019, the city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival; among the featured acts is the jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah.

programme.title: Animal Armoury
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Surviving Earth
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event from the executive producers of Planet Earth, exploring the extraordinary worlds and wildlife of North and South America. Scored by composer Hans Zimmer, the breathtaking journey follows amazing creatures living in their natural habitats across the supercontinent, including diverse terrains like the Atlantic Coast, Mexico, Wild West, Amazon, Frozen North, Gulf Coast, Andes, Caribbean, West Coast and Patagonia. Each location comes alive in never-before-seen footage showing the unique connectedness of the land that millions of people call home.

programme.title: Okavango: River of Dreams
programme.desc: The filmmaker gives a comprehensive insight into the ecosystem of the Okavango river, showcasing a diverse array of wildlife.

programme.title: Lion Queens: Fighting For Survival
programme.desc: A group of lionesses faces growing challenges as changing landscapes and rival predators threaten their survival, pushing them to adapt in new and unexpected ways.

programme.title: Wild Cats

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri starts feeling dizzy while she explains to Indravadhan about the event that had occurred at the breakfast table. Indravadhan holds Gayatri and the rest of the family attend to her. It is revealed that Gayatri has not eaten anything since the morning as she is a vegetarian. Later, Gayatri is about to leave for her house and she takes blessings from Badi Raani Maa. At the event, the portion of saree covering her head falls off and Badi Raani Maa instructs her on it. Later, Indravadhan declines to pick Gayatri from her house as he claims to his mother that the promise he had made has been done. Stay tuned to know more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan tells Raj Mata that he has not filled Gayatri's forehead with sindoor and adds on never filling it. Raj Mata is left shocked and speechless. On the other hand, Kuwar tells Kokila that their son is seeking revenge on Gayatri as she had insulted him in the meeting earlier that morning. Gayatri, on the other hand, rides a cycle alone without any security. She is confronted by some thugs, who try to misbehave with her. A brave Gayatri pick up a rock and keeps the thugs at bay. At the same time, Indravadhan shows up at the scene and saves Gaytri. What will Raj Mata's reaction be when she learns that Gayatri was roaming the street without any security? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri prepares the dishes for the Raj Bhog and checks them. Everything seems to be good as per her plan. She then visits the shooting range where Indravadhan is practicing shooting. She also finds a guard standing nearby and laughs at him seeing his funny moustache. This draws Indravadhan's attention and he decides to teach Gayatri a small lesson. Indravadhan hands the rifle to Gayatri and asks her to shoot the target. Gayatri's shivering hands indicate that she does not wants to learn to shoot. Just as Indravadhan pulls the trigger, Gayatri turns around and hugs him. On the other hand, Kokila mixes some sort of powder into a glass water and waits for the moment for Gayatri to drink it. Will Gayatri drink the water that Kokila has placed in her room? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kokila mixes some sort of powder in the glass of water and places it in Gayatri's room. She eagerly waits for the moment when Gayatri would drink it. Later, the ceremony of crowning Gayatri as the queen of Ameerkot begins. Lord Wilkinson carries out the honour of crowning Gayatri as the queen. But while Wilkinson is about to crown Gayatri as the queen, he insults her and asks her to be loyal to the British government. This infuriates Gayatri and she throws away the crown and claims that she would only loyal to her mother land. Gayatri's statement angers Wilkinson and he declines from crowning Gayatri as the queen. What will Indravadhan do ahead? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Wilkinson engage in a sword fight upon crowning Gayatri as the queen of Ameerkot. Wilkinson overpowers Indravadhan and puts him to the ground. Seeing this, Gayatri rushes to get Indravadhan's favourite sword. She gets the sword on time and hands it to him. Indravadhan then defeats Wilkinson but also shows respect to him. Later, Gayatri again declines to get crowned by Wilkinson and asks Indravadhan to crown her as the queen of Ameerkot. Will Indravadhan accept to crown Gayatri as the queen of Ameerkot? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kokila tells Kunwar that she has planned something which will really cause trouble. Raja mata overhears their conversation and doesn't allow Kokila to leave the room and to stop her sabotage. Kokila and Kunwar manage to exchange the clothes that Gayatri is to wear while she spends the night with Ranaji. The clothes that are exchanged were the same clothes that belonged to Ranaji's late wife, Sulakshana. How will Ranaji react when he sees Gayatri dressed in Sulakshana's clothes? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj Mata meets Indravadhan and learns that he is not going to have his first night. He claims that he only loves Sulakshana and nobody else. It is time and Gayatri gets ready and enters Indravadhan's room. Finding Gayatri dressed as Sulakshana, Indravadhan gets angry. He claims that she is making fun of his wounds. Gayatri claims that she knows nothing about what he is talking. Indravadhan claims that he does not love her. This puts Gayatri in shock and she questions Indravadhan as to why did he save her every time. What will Indravadhan have to say now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gayatri finds out that Ranaji doesn't love her, she goes outside and gets drenched in the rain and cires. She questions why Ranaji married her even though he doesn't love her. Ranaji goes to meet Gayatri and says that her behaviour is not representative of a queen. Gayatri replies that she is not a queen but a common girl with a broken heart. What will Ranaji have to say to Gayatri now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Indravadhan with more questions and asks him to answer all of them. She asks Indravadhan the reason for his hatred towards her. Indravadhan claims the reason why he hates her is because of the treachery she and her father have done in order to make her the queen of Ameerkot. Indravadhan also informs Gayatri about the deal that her father and Raj Mata have made. Gayatri is left flabbergasted hearing this and claims that she knows nothing about the deal. At the same time, Raj Mata meets Gayatri and asks her to get ready for another ritual that needs to be completed. Will Gayatri accept to carry out the ritual even after learning that Indravadhan does not love her? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.15

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.16

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.17
programme.desc: Do Hyun and Ri Jin recall the shocking truth about their past and fall into panic. Meanwhile, Do Hyun learns from Tae Im the full story behind the fire at the Seung Jin mansion 21 years ago.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.
